findings.title: `done` and `test` skip a missing out-of-scope repo silently; the spec requires one ℹ line there too
findings.detail: The spec says a repo declared but missing on disk and outside Phạm vi "is skipped with one `ℹ` line in `status`, `check`, `done` and `test`". Only `check` (commands/check.mjs, `lines = resolved.notes...`) and `status <id>` print `resolved.notes`. In commands/done.mjs `phamViRepo` calls `resolveReposForScope` and keeps only `repos`, so `notes` are thrown away and `done` never prints the line. commands/test.mjs line 45 does the same when `compass test <id>` runs on its own. docs/huong-dan.md:143 and skills/compass/SKILL.md:462 both promise that `done` and `test` print `ℹ Bỏ qua repo "x": …`, so the docs describe output that does not exist. No test covers `done` or `test` here (CP-103-H8 checks only `status` and `check`).

findings.title: "Không áp dụng" with no reason counts as an answer
findings.detail: The spec asks for an explicit "Không áp dụng: <lý do>". `NO_EVIDENCE_NEEDED = /Không thấy trong repo|Không áp dụng/i` matches the bare phrase anywhere in the criterion body, so a criterion answered only with "Không áp dụng" (no reason), or an answer that mentions the phrase in passing ("… Không áp dụng cho file SQL"), passes both `--approve` and the gate with no evidence at all.

findings.title: The gate re-checks evidence in the approved file, so deleting or renaming a cited file blocks unrelated tasks
findings.detail: `quetRepo` runs `problemLines(ownProblems(own, r.dir))` on the approved `conventions/<repo>.md` on every gate run, and `ownProblems` calls `evidenceExists` on the live tree. Evidence was meant to back the answers when they were approved. Once approved, a task that legitimately renames or deletes `src/a.ts` (the file cited for, say, every criterion) turns gate `convention` red with "Không có bằng chứng: 1. Định dạng, …". The hint then tells the agent not to edit the approved file without the reviewer, so a correct refactor is stuck on a convention-file problem it did not cause.

findings.title: `--approve` creates `.knowledge/` and so turns gate `knowledge` red on the next `check`, with no warning
findings.detail: In a multi-repo workspace with no `.knowledge/` yet, the gate `knowledge` passes ("dự án chưa dùng .knowledge"). `writeNoLink` creates `.knowledge/decided/conventions/<repo>.md`, and from then on the knowledge gate expects generated docs and fails (missing manifest/components, reported as docs being stale or deleted). The success hint of `--approve` says only "Chạy lại gate: compass check <id>". The tests avoid this by calling `knowledgeCommand({ sync: true })` first (CP-103-H4/H8, test/helpers/conventions.mjs explains it), but users and agents are not told. Since this gate is now mandatory for every multi-repo task, every new workspace will hit it.

findings.title: CP-103-H2's "root rule is not run on be" check cannot fail
findings.detail: The test checks `doesNotMatch(r.output, /vi phạm mức error/)` to show the root rule `be-no-log` (console.log) was not run on `be`. But `BE_FILES` holds no `console.log`, so running the root rule on `be` would find no violation either. The assertion passes whether the rule runs or not, so the spec's "the rule is not run on `be`" part of H2 has no test.

findings.title: S2 and S4 test a junctioned parent folder only, never the file itself being a link
findings.detail: Spec S2 is "`conventions/be.md` is a symlink or junction to an outside file", and S4 is "the draft file is a symlink or junction". Both tests replace the parent directory (`.knowledge/decided/conventions` or `.compass/conventions-draft`) with a junction. The last-segment check in `readNoLink` (`lstatSync(full).isFile()`) is never run against a file symlink, so a regression there (say, `statSync` in place of `lstatSync` for the final file) would go unnoticed. A file symlink can be skipped on Windows without privilege, as other tests in the repo do.

findings.title: No test for the listed risk "the plain draft now counts the repos that exist when one is missing"
findings.detail: `units()` in lib/convention-draft.mjs now calls `resolveRepos(..., { allowMissing: true })`. Before, a missing repo made it fall back to the whole root. The spec lists this as a regression risk, and it also changes what `conventionStatus`/`currentMarks` count when checking whether an adopted root `conventions.md` is stale. No test drafts or checks staleness in a workspace with a declared repo missing on disk (CP-98's missing-repo case covers only `--draft --repo=`).

findings.title: A repeated criterion heading drops the first body, hiding its `compass-fill`
findings.detail: In `ownProblems`, each `### N.` heading runs `bodies.set(cur, [])`. If a draft or approved file has `### 3.` twice (for example, the agent adds its own `### 3. Cấu trúc thư mục` below the generated one, which still carries `compass-fill`), only the second body is kept. The unanswered marker in the first is never seen, and `--approve` and the gate both pass. Merging bodies for a repeated number, or reporting the duplicate, would close this.

findings.title: Repo-name quoting for commands is copied in one place and missing in three others
findings.detail: `quetRepo` copies the `arg` quoting from `pendingLine` in lib/repo-conventions.mjs (`/^[\w./-]+$/.test(name) ? name : JSON.stringify(name)`) instead of sharing it. The new commands printed elsewhere skip it: the draft header and agent section (`approve` in buildDraft, lib/convention-draft.mjs:700), the `--draft --repo` hint (commands/convention.mjs:362), and the `--approve` E1/V7 hints. `repoPathError` allows spaces, so a repo like `web app` gets `compass convention --approve --repo=web app` printed, and running it as written fails.

findings.title: Docs say root rules "apply to root files", but in a multi-repo workspace the gate never runs them on any file
findings.detail: README.md:214, docs/huong-dan.md:130 and SKILL.md:415 say "luật ở `conventions.md` của gốc chỉ áp cho file của gốc". When `repos` is declared, `conventionCommand` only goes through `quetRepo` for each repo in Phạm vi. Root rules there are only parsed and checked by `rulesTouching`, and no code path runs `runRules` on root files. (`.compass` is also in the walker's SKIP_DIRS, so even `.compass/scripts/**` rules match nothing.) A reader will think root files are protected by root rules, but nothing enforces them.

findings.title: AGENTS.md and the gate's own hint still send multi-repo users to the plain `--draft`, whose rules now turn the gate red
findings.detail: templates/AGENTS.md:94 tells the agent to run plain `compass convention --draft` on `⚠ Gốc chưa có convention đã duyệt`. `conventionStatus` (shown by `init` and after every gate run through `withStatus`) prints `chạy: compass convention --draft`, and the earlier AGENTS.md section says to act on it "không chờ ai bảo". In a multi-repo workspace that draft proposes rules like `scope: **/*.js`. Once adopted at the root, `rulesTouching` makes every repo red. SKILL.md warns about this (and the spec says the docs should point to `--draft --repo=`), but AGENTS.md, the file copied into users' projects, does not.
